flagged.evidence: At 1.3 the proof says, “If K=1, choose a unit vector v spanning im P,” citing [F1, F2, L1, given]. [F1] states only that every finite-dimensional inner-product subspace has an orthonormal basis; it does not establish that im P is one-dimensional. The explicit calculation dim im V=K appears later in 2.1. The missing fact follows immediately from isometry injectivity and rank-nullity, so this is a nonfatal justification gap.
